column3: A failed idle delete is reported and retried every 5 minutes at most 12 times (1 hour), then the session is marked closed and the last failure stays in the task's reports
column4: XIN-32 Low: unbounded retries kept a background task and its alarm alive forever for a machine Instabox would not delete; an hour covers host_unavailable and maintenance windows, and the report names the machine for the owner
column5: code review of session.ts close phase; no fake failure path for deletes
